summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), extracts it to a tempdir, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (rotated string-array via `WV8StW`, hex-numeric `_0xXXXX` identifiers, `@bun @bun-cjs` header) with no readable purpose and no reference from the library's main entry. The package is advertised as a Vue event-calendar component, so fetching a second language runtime at install time and executing an opaque bundled payload with it has no relationship to the declared purpose. Executing an obfuscated bundled payload via an alternate downloaded runtime bypasses inspection of Node-resolved code and runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine on `npm install` before the developer has interacted with the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
